structure.unit: Commercial Code — Warehouse Receipts, Bills of Lading and Other Documents of Title

law.catch_line: Title under warehouse receipt defeated in certain cases
law.text: A buyer in the ordinary course of business of fungible goods sold and delivered by a warehouseman who is also in the business of buying and selling such goods takes the goods free of any claim under a warehouse receipt even though the receipt is negotiable and has been duly negotiated.
